title: Lead Support Engineer
description:
**Job Summary** 




  





 IT Support Lead Engineer acts as
 **Level 3 support staff in the IT SD Support escalation matrix** 
 . As a lead engineer, you should have a solid technical background with Microsoft products, ticketing systems, security products like AV, DLP, Firewall, patch management. A problem\-solving attitude with an ability to train new hire and existing staff, can document troubleshooting and training KB articles, coaches’ team on technical issues. Can co\-ordinate with different cross functional team members, vendors for escalated issue resolution.
 



  





**Responsibilities and Duties** 




 1\. Act as L3 escalation point for unresolved cases and come up with a technical way ahead for challenging and unsolved IT SD Support cases.
 



 2\. Acts as technical mentor on floor to offer quick technical assistance to L1 and L2 engineers.
 



 3\. Trains new hires with IT SD technical training program.
 



 4\. Train, coach, and mentor L1/L2 Technical Support Engineers on technical aspects.
 



 5\. Acts as problem manager to come out with resolution for IT SD escalations and IT projects.
 



 6\. Demonstrable ability to think around issues and look at the wider picture in order to provide
 



 solutions through a variety of problem\-solving techniques.
 



 7\. Acts as technical SME on floor for ticket resolution.
 



 8\. Document organization SOP for various solutions implementation and maintenance related management.
 



 9\. Create internal and end user’s KB Articles.
 



 10\. Conduct technical awareness and troubleshooting trainings for existing staff.
 



 11\. Create SOP on recurring issues to capture troubleshooting steps.
 



 12\. Vendor management for product related deployment, upgrade, and escalation management.
 



 13\. Knowledge and understanding of best practice frameworks (such as ITIL, ISO20k).
 



  





**Desired skills \& competencies** 




 1\. Graduate in any discipline.
 



 2\. Expert in Microsoft products like desktop and server O.S., AD/Domain controller, WSUS, Bit locker, Exchange Server, O365\.
 



 3\. Sound knowledge of Endpoint security, DLP Products, WDS, SCCM.
 



 4\. Sound knowledge of windows OS, MS Severs, endpoints hardware and related troubleshooting.
 



 5\. At least 10 years \+ years of total IT experience with minimum 5 years of experience with IT Helpdesk / service desk in resolving technical escalation at level 2 and above profile.
 



 6\. Microsoft/O365 Certification.
 



 7\. Networking, security certification is an added advantage.
 



 8\. Drive, self\-motivation, and ability to work under own initiative.
 



 9\. Excellent customer Service Skills, Excellent problem\-solving skills.
 



 10\. Proactive and creative, Attention to detail, Excellent research skills.
 



 11\. Excellent English communication skill (both Written \& Verbal).
 



 12\. Customer\-centric
 



 13\. Problem Solver
 



 14\. Critical thinker
 



 15\. Can work under pressure
 



 16\. Multi\-tasking.
